newsitem.title: THAILAND: United Communication units in share issue.
newsitem.headline: United Communication units in share issue.

text.p: Thai telecommunications company United Communication Industry Plc will inject capital into subsidiaries via a tranche of new share issues, the company said in a statement on friday.

United Tactical Communication Co will issue 200,000 new shares at 100 baht per share, Ucom International Co Ltd will issue five million new shares at 100 baht per share, and Rialtime Co Ltd will issue 15 million new shares at 10 baht per share, the statement said.
The parent company will buy all the new shares, the statement said. ($1 = 31 baht)
